messages:
alex: Anyone else seeing a p95 spike on mistral7b nodes after enabling sliding-window prefetch? Started ~this morning, p95 ~2.3x on long-history requests.

maria: Yup, saw it during the nightly run. I profiled a few traces — kernel selector is switching to a 'wide_tile' path for seq > 2048 even when kv_shard is enabled. Causes big memcpy + thread divergence.

jon: Can you drop the nvprof / flamegraph snippet?

maria: nvprof snapshot (trimmed):
```
attention_kernel_wide_tile  58.1%  (kernel)
fused_attn_small          7.9%  (kernel)
H2D_memcpy                19.7%
KV_copy_tile              6.2%
other kernels             8.1%
```
This is from a single long request (seq ~ 2700) batch=1.

sasha: Is this regression visible for larger batches too or just batch=1 long seq?

maria: Mostly batch=1 long seq. Our batching heuristics biased toward small-batch path when variance high; kernel chooser then sees the long-seq tail and prefers wide_tile which scales poorly for small batches.

ethan: I ran into a related oddity on 8x7b when someone bumped max_position_embeddings to 4096 — RoPE scaling triggered a mask fallback into a slower generic path. Masks + kernel choice together created a perfect storm.

jon: Quick mitigation: force kernel override for the small-batch/long-seq corner. Example runtime override we tested:
```json
{"kernel_overrides": {"mistral7b": [{"seq_min":1024, "seq_max":4096, "batch_max":4, "kernel":"fused_attn_small"}]}}
```
Applied as a hotfix on one pool.

maria: Results from the hotfix A/B: p95 for long-seq requests dropped from ~520ms -> ~210ms (pool with override). Overall token cost for those requests +3% but latency tail improved massively.

perf-bot: perf-alert: p95 increase detected for mistral7b sliding-window prefetch on pool-us-west-2 at 2026-03-18T09:12:37Z (rule: p95_delta > 1.5x).

sasha: Longer-term we should: 1) add a stability window before kernel selector flips (require histogram N>50 requests), 2) make the selector factor in current KV bytes (if KV > X, avoid wide_tile), 3) prefer merge paths that minimize memcpy for small batches.

jon: I'll add the batching-heuristic unit tests and a sim that replays seq histograms to CI. Expect a small PR tomorrow to require min_count in selector.

ethan: Also a note on RoPE handling: if max_pos_embeddings > model_base_pos, prefer remapping indices to base_range instead of forcing full-scale mask compute. That avoids switching to generic mask path in many cases. I have a patch sketch.

alex: Plan summary:
- Alex: create telemetry alert + rollout hotfix to block pool-wide deploys until kernel override applied.
- Jon: batching selector min-count + unit tests.
- Sasha: schedule perf rerun and end-to-end repro for long-history traces.
- Maria: investigate whether KV shard config is being ignored when chooser flips.
- Ethan: work RoPE remap patch.

alex: Assigned and noted in the incident board. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
